network_enforcement: When the pinned Lean artifact closure is usable, every fresh Lean subprocess runs inside bubblewrap --unshare-net. The checker never fetches or updates dependencies. A missing or corrupt pinned artifact is recorded as a blocker and the release decision remains fail-closed.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line PASS/BLOCKED release reconciliation summary

scope_boundary: Current-snapshot fail-closed release reconciliation. If the existing pinned dependency artifacts are usable, it additionally performs a trust-zero, fresh-output, network-isolated replay of the exact statement, conditional composition, two implementations of the degenerate branch, and a conditional root probe. It cannot accept the validation dependency, provide the missing positive-maximum package or premise-free exact root, supply H0/R0 or complete foundation/provenance/TCB closure, perform a clean cold/offline supply-chain replay, provide distinct signed runners or an independent minimal verifier, assemble a deterministic release bundle, or establish AUDIT-Z/THEOREM-Z.
